mapper.select: SELECT strategy_case.strategy_case_id, strategy_case.sku_id, strategy_case.case_name, strategy_case.case_status, strategy_case.generation_stage, strategy_case.result_expires_at, strategy_case.result_cache_key, requester.user_id AS requester_id, requester.user_name AS requester_name, requester.organization_id AS requester_organization_id FROM strategy_case JOIN app_user requester ON requester.user_id = strategy_case.created_by WHERE strategy_case.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0

SELECT strategy_case.strategy_case_id, strategy_case.sku_id, strategy_case.case_name, strategy_case.case_status, strategy_case.generation_stage, strategy_case.result_expires_at, strategy_case.result_cache_key, requester.user_id AS requester_id, requester.user_name AS requester_name, requester.organization_id AS requester_organization_id FROM strategy_case JOIN app_user requester ON requester.user_id = strategy_case.created_by WHERE strategy_case.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE OF strategy_case.case_status

SELECT final_selection.final_selection_id, final_selection.strategy_option_id, strategy_option.option_rank, strategy_option.constraint_text FROM final_strategy_selection final_selection JOIN strategy_option ON strategy_option.strategy_option_id = final_selection.strategy_option_id AND strategy_option.is_deleted = 0 WHERE final_selection.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND final_selection.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY final_selection.created_at DESC, final_selection.final_selection_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT strategy_case.strategy_case_id, case_requester.organization_id AS requester_organization_id, strategy_case.case_status, final_selection.final_selection_id, strategy_option.strategy_option_id, strategy_option.constraint_text, strategy_case.case_name, sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, selection_requester.user_name AS requester_name, strategy_option.option_name, strategy_option.recommendation_reason, simulation.target_quantity, simulation.strategy_price, simulation.expected_sales_qty, simulation.expected_revenue, simulation.total_contribution_margin, simulation.expected_remaining_qty, execution_result.planned_start_date, execution_result.planned_end_date FROM strategy_case JOIN sku ON sku.sku_id = strategy_case.sku_id AND sku.is_deleted = 0 JOIN app_user case_requester ON case_requester.user_id = strategy_case.created_by LEFT JOIN final_strategy_selection final_selection ON final_selection.strategy_case_id = strategy_case.strategy_case_id AND final_selection.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN strategy_option ON strategy_option.strategy_option_id = final_selection.strategy_option_id AND strategy_option.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN strategy_simulation simulation ON simulation.strategy_option_id = strategy_option.strategy_option_id AND simulation.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN strategy_execution_result execution_result ON execution_result.final_selection_id = final_selection.final_selection_id AND execution_result.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN app_user selection_requester ON selection_requester.user_id = final_selection.created_by WHERE strategy_case.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY final_selection.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, final_selection.final_selection_id DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT action.action_type, action.target_sales_point_id, target.sales_point_name AS target_sales_point_name, action.strategy_price, action.discount_rate, action.action_order FROM strategy_action action LEFT JOIN sales_point target ON target.sales_point_id = action.target_sales_point_id AND target.is_deleted = 0 WHERE action.strategy_option_id = #{strategyOptionId} AND action.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY action.action_order, action.strategy_action_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_option ( strategy_case_id, option_rank, option_name, recommendation_reason, advantage_text, caution_text, constraint_text, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{strategyCaseId}, #{optionRank}, #{optionName}, #{recommendationReason}, #{advantageText}, #{cautionText}, #{constraintText}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )

INSERT INTO strategy_simulation ( strategy_option_id, input_source_type, target_quantity, strategy_price, movement_cost, expected_sales_qty, expected_revenue, unit_contribution_margin, contribution_margin_rate, total_contribution_margin, expected_remaining_qty, expected_sell_through_days, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{strategyOptionId}, #{inputSourceType}, #{targetQuantity}, #{strategyPrice}, #{movementCost}, #{expectedSalesQty}, #{expectedRevenue}, #{unitContributionMargin}, #{contributionMarginRate}, #{totalContributionMargin}, #{expectedRemainingQty}, #{expectedSellThroughDays}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )

INSERT INTO strategy_action ( strategy_option_id, source_sales_point_id, target_sales_point_id, source_warehouse_id, destination_warehouse_id, action_type, action_quantity, strategy_price, discount_rate, start_date, end_date, estimated_action_cost, action_order, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{strategyOptionId}, #{sourceSalesPointId}, #{targetSalesPointId}, #{sourceWarehouseId}, #{destinationWarehouseId}, #{actionType}, #{actionQuantity}, #{strategyPrice}, #{discountRate}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{estimatedActionCost}, #{actionOrder}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )

INSERT INTO strategy_lot_allocation ( lot_id, allocated_quantity, priority_no, source_warehouse_id, source_sales_point_id, strategy_action_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{lotId}, #{allocatedQuantity}, #{priorityNo}, #{sourceWarehouseId}, #{sourceSalesPointId}, #{strategyActionId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )

INSERT INTO strategy_inventory_snapshot ( strategy_case_id, sku_id, lot_id, sales_point_id, inventory_balance_id, on_total_qty, on_hand_qty, safety_stock_qty, daily_sales_velocity, forecast_qty, expiry_date, warehouse_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{strategyCaseId}, #{skuId}, #{lotId}, #{salesPointId}, #{inventoryBalanceId}, #{onTotalQty}, #{onHandQty}, #{safetyStockQty}, #{dailySalesVelocity}, #{forecastQty}, #{expiryDate}, #{warehouseId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )

INSERT INTO strategy_price_snapshot ( strategy_case_id, sku_id, sales_point_id, current_price, product_cost, payment_fee, logistics_cost, unit_variable_cost, baseline_unit_contribution_margin, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{strategyCaseId}, #{skuId}, #{salesPointId}, #{currentPrice}, #{productCost}, #{paymentFee}, #{logisticsCost}, #{unitVariableCost}, #{baselineUnitContributionMargin}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )

INSERT INTO final_strategy_selection ( strategy_case_id, strategy_option_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{strategyCaseId}, #{strategyOptionId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )

INSERT INTO strategy_forecast_snapshot ( final_selection_id, sales_point_id, model_version_id, forecast_role, forecast_run_id, strategy_period_predicted_qty, forecast_30d_qty, forecast_60d_qty, forecast_90d_qty, forecast_180d_qty, daily_forecast_json, input_data_hash, forecast_generated_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{finalSelectionId}, #{salesPointId}, #{modelVersionId}, #{forecastRole}, #{forecastRunId}, #{strategyPeriodPredictedQty}, #{forecast30dQty}, #{forecast60dQty}, #{forecast90dQty}, #{forecast180dQty}, #{dailyForecastJson}, #{inputDataHash}, #{forecastGeneratedAt}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )

INSERT INTO strategy_execution_result ( final_selection_id, result_status, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, goal_metric_code, goal_target_value, start_risk_stock_qty, start_expected_disposal_qty, start_unit_cost, calculation_version, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{finalSelectionId}, #{resultStatus}, #{plannedStartDate}, #{plannedEndDate}, #{goalMetricCode}, #{goalTargetValue}, #{startRiskStockQty}, #{startExpectedDisposalQty}, #{startUnitCost}, #{calculationVersion}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )

INSERT INTO strategy_review_request ( strategy_option_id, requester_id, reviewer_id, review_status, teams_message_id, strategy_url, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{strategyOptionId}, #{requesterId}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewStatus}, #{teamsMessageId}, #{strategyUrl}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT review_request_id, reviewer_id, review_status FROM strategy_review_request WHERE strategy_option_id = #{strategyOptionId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY reviewer_id

SELECT request.review_request_id, request.reviewer_id, request.review_status, request.updated_at, reviewer.user_name AS reviewer_name, reviewer.email AS reviewer_email, reviewer.active_yn AS reviewer_active_yn, reviewer.is_deleted AS reviewer_is_deleted, requester.user_name AS requester_name FROM strategy_review_request request LEFT JOIN app_user reviewer ON reviewer.user_id = request.reviewer_id LEFT JOIN app_user requester ON requester.user_id = request.requester_id WHERE request.strategy_option_id = #{strategyOptionId} AND request.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY request.reviewer_id
SELECT review_request_id, reviewer_id, review_status, updated_at FROM strategy_review_request WHERE review_request_id = #{reviewRequestId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy_review_request SET review_status = 'SENDING', updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actorId} WHERE review_request_id = #{reviewRequestId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND ( review_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') OR ( review_status = 'SENDING' AND updated_at < SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{claimTimeoutSeconds}, 'SECOND') ) )

UPDATE strategy_review_request SET review_status = #{reviewStatus}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actorId} WHERE review_request_id = #{reviewRequestId} AND review_status = 'SENDING' AND is_deleted = 0
